summary: Square's dual-protagonist PlayStation action RPG, released as Dewprism in Japan and later reissued through PlayStation Network.

entries.title: Threads of Fate

emulation.notes: Use internal resolution scaling and conservative visual options for clean capture.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original PlayStation assets with high-quality PS1 emulation and modern capture.

primary.why: Threads of Fate has no sourced modern remaster; the original PlayStation release is the complete version, with DuckStation providing the best owned-copy fidelity/capture route.
primary.how_to_play: Play an owned PlayStation disc or image through DuckStation with internal resolution scaling. The PSN release is an older official digital route where still accessible.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced modern remaster or remake.
